content: Hello, this is Brenda from Sunrise Medical Billing. How may I assist you with your account today?
Hi Brenda, I just paid my hospital bill but I'm not sure if it went through. Can you check for me? The payment should be under my name, Marcus Lee.

Let me take a look, Marcus. I see a recent transaction for $1,280.50 made via Zelle on June 21st, associated with your patient ID ML-453218. The payment reference is ZEL-23918764. Is that the one you're referring to?
Yes, that's correct. I sent it from marcus.lee@email.com. Is it definitely matched to my account?
Absolutely, the payment from marcus.lee@email.com is linked to your Sunrise Patient Portal profile. The funds were credited at 11:04 AM today, so your account status now shows as paid in full.
Okay, thanks. Would it have been faster if I used PayPal or another service?

Great question! Zelle typically processes payments within minutes, which is why your transaction posted so quickly. PayPal can sometimes take up to 24 hours, and direct bank transfers using your IBAN, such as NL89BANK0563729184, might take 1-2 business days. For urgent hospital billing, Zelle is usually your fastest option.
That's useful to know. Will I get an emailed receipt?

Yes, an electronic receipt was sent to marcus.lee@email.com and your registered phone number ending in 4418 within five minutes of payment confirmation. If you need it resent, just let me know right away, we can handle that before the day's cutoff.
